note: Steward of Gondor: fire caster. His own flames (Denethor/ExtraPose02 in OBJ:3), the palantir (gondor_palantir art), the Citadel guard (GondorSoldier), the pyre (gondor_beacon).

passives.name: Steward of Gondor
passives.text: Robes of the Steward: +2 melee and +2 missile armor per level.

passives.name: Lore of Numenor
passives.text: +5 max Spirit and +1 Spirit regeneration per level.

passives.name: Proud Lineage
passives.text: Blood of Numenor: +1 Strength and +2 fire damage per level.

passives.name: Long Sight
passives.text: He sees far: +2% critical chance and +1 Accuracy per level.

passives.name: Iron Will
passives.text: +8% fear resistance and +1 Courage per level.

passives.name: Bitter Grief
passives.text: Below a quarter health he hits 3 harder per level.

passives.name: Seat of the Steward
passives.text: +5 max health and +1 health regeneration per level.

passives.name: Ember Heart
passives.text: The fire is his own: +4 fire protection and +1 health regeneration per level.

passives.name: Long Despair
passives.text: Grief feeds the flame: +1 Spirit per hit and +1 Spirit regeneration per level.

skills.name: Pyre-Flame
skills.text: Fire leaps onto the nearest foe: {damage} damage and it burns.

skills.name: The Palantir
skills.text: The seeing-stone shows doom: foes around take {damage}, are stunned {stun} and slowed.

skills.name: Despair
skills.text: He feeds his own life to the fire: pays 15% health, and for {seconds}s his spells deal {amount}% more.

skills.name: Lord of the White Tower
skills.text: The Steward's pride: for {seconds}s arrows and blows from afar lose {amount}% of their harm.

skills.name: Madness
skills.text: Madness takes him: for {seconds}s his blows deal {amount}% more, but he takes 25% more damage.

skills.name: Pyre of the Stewards
skills.text: The pyre is lit: {damage} damage all around, foes burn and are thrown back.
